subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or supersede the conflicting fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1564 so a fresh narrow active-runtime fix can proceed?
rationale: Automation should not queue another fix while an open closing-syntax PR claims the issue, but that PR is conflicting and targets an obsolete handler path.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork PR, then queue a narrow fix
options.body: This clears the stale implementation candidate and lets the fix target `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and live proof.

options.title: Adopt and repair the fork PR manually
options.body: A maintainer can take over the useful intent, but most of the branch would need to move from the removed handler path to the active runtime.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: This avoids immediate maintainer cleanup but leaves the source-reproducible bug and automation blockage in place.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the fork PR, then queue a narrow fix
recommendation.body: This clears the stale implementation candidate and lets the fix target `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame touches the active Telegram approval runtime, and the decision is mainly repository workflow cleanup around the stale linked PR.
